scope: TTS only; Swift SDK vs direct Objective-C++ bridge from the same compiled native object. Same model path, AVAudioConverter reference decoding, userInitiated serial queue, seed 11. Each backend has 3 ordered four-case cycles; reference-free and synthetic-reference-with-caption variants. Not a complete Local AI pipeline or original PyTorch comparison.
conditions: Other SBV2 Core ML/PyTorch comparisons ran concurrently; thermal state was fair. Timing is retained but not used for performance regression conclusions.
